name: seo-rank-fixer
description: Your Google Search Console data and the SEO fixes worth the most clicks, in ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
SEO Rank Fixer reads your Google Search Console data and ranks every SEO fix by the extra clicks it could win: pages stuck just off page one, titles that rank but don't get clicked, and pages competing with each other for the same search.

Ask in plain words and get answers from your real data:
- How is my site doing? Clicks, impressions, click-through rate and average position against the previous period, with a trend chart.
- What should I fix first? The fixes worth the most clicks, each with why it matters and the steps to take.
- Scan any public page for SEO, answer-engine and AI-crawler problems, with a score out of 100.
- Explore top queries and pages, countries and devices, and get suggested titles, meta descriptions and content briefs.

Sign in with your SEO Rank Fixer account. SEO Rank Fixer only reads your data: it never changes your website or your Search Console settings, and you can disconnect ChatGPT at any time under Settings, Connected AI apps.
capabilities: Rank SEO fixes by estimated clicks
Scan public pages for SEO issues
defaultPrompt: What should I fix first to get more Google clicks?
How did my site do in Google over the last 28 days?

positive.description: List the connected sites and plan
positive.prompt: Which sites do I have in SEO Rank Fixer?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the test account's sites with their sync status.

positive.description: Site performance for the last 28 days
positive.prompt: How did seorankfixer.com do in Google over the last 28 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows clicks, impressions, CTR and average position with the change against the previous 28 days and a trend chart, using only the returned numbers.

positive.prompt: What should I fix first on seorankfixer.com to get more clicks?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the open fixes ranked by estimated extra clicks a month, each with why it matters and the steps.
Shows a score out of 100 and each finding with its severity and what to change.

positive.prompt: Which search queries bring seorankfixer.com the most clicks?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the top queries with clicks, impressions, CTR and position against the previous period.

review.commerce_description: SEO Rank Fixer does not sell products, subscriptions or credits, show plans or prices, or take payments in ChatGPT. When a feature is not included in the user's current plan, it says so in plain words.

publication.release_notes: Site performance, top fixes, page scans, index status, site audit, search reports and suggested fixes, with in-chat cards. Plan-limit replies in ChatGPT are now plain statements with no prices or upgrade links.
